title: Model Discovery Agent: LLM-assisted Bayesian experiment design for data-efficient discovery of mechanistic world models
abstract: arXiv:2608.09696v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Predicting the answer to interventional ``what if'' questions --- the outcome of an action never taken --- requires a \emph{mechanistic}, causal model, not a curve fit; and learning such a model requires \emph{experiments}, because passive data leaves its mechanisms unidentified. Experiments are expensive, so the central problem is \emph{data efficiency}. We present the Model Discovery Agent (MDA), which couples a large language model (LLM), used as a \emph{proposer} of candidate structures, with standard Bayesian machinery --- sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) for parameter and structure posteriors, simulation-based inference (SBI) for intractable likelihoods, and value-of-information (VoI) for experiment design --- to discover latent mechanistic world models from few interventions. MDA operates in the M-open setting: when the truth lies outside the current hypothesis class, a predictive check flags the inadequacy and the proposer expand

translated_title: 模型发现代理：LLM辅助的贝叶斯实验设计用于数据高效发现机制性世界模型
translated_abstract: 摘要：预测干预性“如果……会怎样”问题的答案——即从未采取行动的结果——需要机制性因果模型，而非曲线拟合；学习此类模型需要实验，因为被动数据无法识别其机制。实验成本高昂，因此核心问题是数据效率。我们提出了模型发现代理（MDA），它将大型语言模型（LLM）作为候选结构的提议者，与标准贝叶斯机制——顺序蒙特卡洛（SMC）用于参数和结构后验、基于模拟的推断（SBI）用于难处理似然、信息价值（VoI）用于实验设计——相结合，以从少量干预中发现潜在机制性世界模型。MDA在M-open设置中运行：当真实情况位于当前假设类别之外时，预测检查会标记不足，提议者则扩展假设类别。
tldr: MDA通过将LLM作为结构提议者与贝叶斯推断和实验设计相结合，在M-open设置中实现从少量干预中数据高效地发现机制性世界模型。
en_tdlr: MDA integrates an LLM as a structure proposer with Bayesian inference and experiment design to data-efficiently discover mechanistic world models from few interventions in the M-open setting.
